question: Does per-group damping (velocity and height feedback) plus a hit-only strike bonus produce a policy that passes the motor gate AND beats the frozen v0.0.16 champion head-to-head with a positive Elo lower bound, in games won with real head/torso hits?
owner_requirements: gb_feedback_0528: preregister v0.0.18 with a concrete Elo/win-rate gate vs the v0.0.16 champion
gb_feedback_0313/0314: level-up = motor gate + head-to-head with valid games
gb_feedback_0110: valid-game floor >= 50% before any Elo claim
context: v0.0.17 (protocol 850ec810): stance 7/24, reach 24/24, median stand 2.682 s; level-up not met. Exploratory: all v0.0.17 strikes land on the opponent's glove/guard (0 head/torso in 6 replayed gate seeds), and its 14 exploratory wins vs v0.0.13 were a glove tap followed by the opponent's own fall (grokbot/redteam/cycle-0023.md F1/F2).
classification: single-athlete motor diagnostic in the shared two-person world; not boxing, not self-play, not an Elo claim
env: grokbot.scenarios.RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000); unchanged jekko env; runs to the horizon (does not stop at the first fall)
opponent: frozen v0.0.11 gen4 posture policy (deterministic) in corner B

candidate.kind: grokbot.motor_primitives.GroupPDPolicy: GroupFeedbackPolicy (1,112) + per-group gains on selfplay.FEATURES[6:] (pelvis linear/angular velocity, height): 138 x 7 = 966 new params, 2,078 total
candidate.init: group_pd_params(v0.0.17 final_params from grokbot/redteam/data/cycle-0022-group-feedback-gate-summary.json): rate gains 0, commands identical to the v0.0.17 candidate at iteration 0

training.method: grokbot.motor_gate.train antithetic ES with CRN against the frozen gen4 posture

gate.stance_pass: candidate stands (no persistent non-foot floor support) for the full 3000 ticks
gate.reach_pass: candidate lands >= 1 strike tick (approach and referee active speed >= 0.5 m/s on a strike target)
gate.also_reported: scoring_reach_rate (share of trials with >= 1 head/torso hit); not part of the primary gate

head_to_head.runs: unconditionally, after the motor gate (reported whatever the gate result)
head_to_head.env: grokbot.reference_env.ReferenceEndingEnv(RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000), anti_stalling=True) via grokbot.selfplay.play_game (ending variant grokbot-ending-reference-v2, unchanged)
head_to_head.opponent: frozen v0.0.16 champion: kind group, v0.0.16 final_params from grokbot/redteam/data/cycle-0020-group-gate-summary.json, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.sides: each seed with the candidate in corner A and in corner B (48 games)
head_to_head.valid: grokbot.selfplay.valid_result (not no-contest, not blocked, not an engine fault); every game stays in the denominator
head_to_head.samples: grokbot.promotion._utilities over valid games: games sharing a seed are averaged into one paired sample
head_to_head.elo: Elo = 400*log10(p/(1-p)) with p = (1+mean)/2 clipped to [0.5/n, 1-0.5/n]; Elo lower bound from p_low = (1+lower95)/2 (-inf if p_low <= 0); win rate = wins / valid games with a Wilson 95% interval (descriptive)
head_to_head.pass: ALL of: (a) valid games >= 50% of the 48; (b) lower95 > 0 (equivalently Elo lower bound > 0); (c) at least half of the candidate's valid wins include >= 1 candidate head/torso hit (scoring_strike_ticks > 0)

criteria.primary_motor_gate: stance_pass_rate >= 0.50 AND reach_pass_rate >= 0.50 over the same 24 gate trials (v0.0.15/v0.0.16 seeds, opponent, horizon)
criteria.secondary: one-sided exact sign test on paired gate stand ticks vs the v0.0.17 candidate (re-run on the same seeds; also checked per trial against the committed v0.0.17 summary), p < 0.05
criteria.level_up: v0.0.18 is a level-up (tagged) iff the primary motor gate AND the Elo gate pass

pre_declared_readings: no stand gain over v0.0.17: linear per-group feedback is saturated; next lever is recurrent control or jekko's pretrained bridge
stand gain, gate still fails: report, keep scaling the controller
scoring_reach_rate stays 0: hit-only bonus gives no gradient from glove taps; next: shaping on glove-to-head distance at strike time
Elo gate (a) fails: games still undecided (no-contest) - candidate does not strike before the opponent's fall
Elo gate (b) passes but (c) fails: wins come from glove taps + opponent's own fall, not hits; not a level-up
both pass: tag v0.0.18; next preregister a two-player league from the v0.0.18 policy with this Elo gate
